title: Tap/hold push intent and authored push sequencing
scope: regular and mongo push tap input
regular and mongo held push input
PushStart, PushContact, PushCycle, and PushEnd leaf sequencing
single active sequence leaf with no stale animation loop

retail_evidence.claim: PushStart transitions at WillExpire 0.01; CYC1/CYC2 use transType sequence; PushCycle returns to PushContact; PushEnd blends for 0.2 seconds and exits at WillExpire 0.1.
Authoritative 60 Hz full-skeleton push leaves, including the hard-strength branches.
PushCycle::Begin and PushCycle::Update preserve push intent state and distinguish continuing/new push intent from release.
The regular low-speed hard push exports 41 INTO, 13 CYC1, and 55 CYC2 samples at native 60 Hz with full-skeleton matrix validation.

required_observations: A tap produces one complete hard push and never a ghost second loop.
Holding push repeats CYC1/CYC2 without replaying INTO.
Releasing held push reaches PushEnd cleanly.
The 55-frame CYC2 reads as the extracted whole-body hard push.

human_checks: Tap Space once from idle: one complete regular hard push plays, including torso and arm motion, then returns to riding.
Hold Space: the rider continues pushing without replaying PushStart; release and verify a clean PushEnd.
Repeat the same tap and hold checks with Left Shift for mongo.
Rapidly tap push and verify no older INTO/CYC leaf keeps playing underneath the current leaf.
known_out_of_scope_unknowns: The exact runtime ComputeRepushDeadline value and the frame-level BreakOutOfPush release threshold still require a retail runtime capture.
The exact transitionUnder/applyPosture contribution from the riding graph still requires final-matrix comparison against the retail runtime.
